viral.name: Viral
viral.reminderText: When you play this, add a copy to your hand that costs (1) less (minimum 1) and loses Viral.

spotlight.name: Spotlight
spotlight.reminderText: Enemies must attack characters with Spotlight before other targets.

parasocial.name: Parasocial
parasocial.reminderText: When you target this friendly character with a card or ability, it gains +1/+1 and you gain 1 Obsession.

trending.name: Trending
trending.reminderText: While in your hand, costs (1) less for each other card you've played this turn (minimum 1).

collab.reminderText: Bonus effect if you control another character sharing the stated Current, faction, or tag.

comeback.name: Comeback
comeback.reminderText: When this is defeated, return it to your hand at the start of your next turn.

raid.name: Raid
raid.reminderText: Can attack the turn it is played.

touch-grass.name: Touch Grass
touch-grass.reminderText: Banish a character until the start of your next turn; it returns with base stats and no statuses or attachments.

afterparty.name: Afterparty
afterparty.reminderText: Triggers at the end of your turn.

rushwind.name: Rushwind
rushwind.reminderText: Bonus if this is not the first card you played this turn.

flow.name: Flow
flow.reminderText: Triggers when a friendly card is returned to your hand, replayed, healed, or exchanged.

grow.name: Grow
grow.reminderText: Upgrades permanently after surviving the stated number of your turns.

overload.name: Overload
overload.reminderText: You have that much less Hype next turn.

inspire.name: Inspire
inspire.reminderText: Triggers when this or another friendly character is healed, shielded, or buffed.

corrupt.name: Corrupt
corrupt.reminderText: Replaces a card's or effect's normal benefit with the stated darker version.

refract.name: Refract
refract.reminderText: When played, choose a Current available to your deck; this card becomes that Current while in play.
